records.context: Touching label pairs, rendered for a person to call merge or keep.
records.label: spacr._merge_pairs#0
records.source: Touching label pairs, rendered for a person to call merge or keep.
records.translation: 사람이 병합 또는 유지를 판정하도록 렌더링한 맞닿은 레이블 쌍입니다.

records.context: A segmenter that cuts one object in two leaves two labels that touch along a long shared edge. :func:`spacr.object_classifier.split_candidates` finds such pairs by geometry; this module turns them into a review set that a person labels one pair at a time.
records.label: spacr._merge_pairs#1
records.source: A segmenter that cuts one object in two leaves two labels that touch along a long shared edge. :func:`spacr.object_classifier.split_candidates` finds such pairs by geometry; this module turns them into a review set that a person labels one pair at a time.
records.translation: 하나의 객체를 둘로 자른 분할기는 긴 공유 경계를 따라 맞닿은 두 레이블을 남깁니다. :func:`spacr.object_classifier.split_candidates` 는 기하학적 특성으로 이러한 쌍을 찾고, 이 모듈은 이를 사람이 한 번에 한 쌍씩 레이블을 지정하는 검토 세트로 만듭니다.

records.context: The set is an ordinary Annotate source. Every pair is one PNG under ``<folder>/data/merge_pairs/`` with label A outlined white and label B yellow, and one row in ``png_list`` of ``<folder>/measurements/ measurements.db``. The verdict goes to the ``merge`` column: ``1`` one object cut in two, ``2`` two objects, ``3`` cannot tell. A set built here can therefore also be opened in the Annotate grid, and any script that reads ``png_list`` reads the verdicts.
records.label: spacr._merge_pairs#2
records.source: The set is an ordinary Annotate source. Every pair is one PNG under ``<folder>/data/merge_pairs/`` with label A outlined white and label B yellow, and one row in ``png_list`` of ``<folder>/measurements/ measurements.db``. The verdict goes to the ``merge`` column: ``1`` one object cut in two, ``2`` two objects, ``3`` cannot tell. A set built here can therefore also be opened in the Annotate grid, and any script that reads ``png_list`` reads the verdicts.
records.translation: 이 세트는 일반적인 Annotate 소스입니다. 각 쌍은 ``<folder>/data/merge_pairs/`` 아래의 PNG 하나로, 레이블 A는 흰색, 레이블 B는 노란색 윤곽선으로 표시되며, ``png_list`` 에 행 하나가 있습니다(``<folder>/measurements/ measurements.db``). 판정은 ``merge`` 열에 저장됩니다. ``1`` 은 둘로 잘린 하나의 객체, ``2`` 는 두 객체, ``3`` 은 판단 불가입니다. 따라서 여기서 만든 세트는 Annotate 그리드에서도 열 수 있으며, ``png_list`` 를 읽는 모든 스크립트가 판정을 읽습니다.

records.context: A PNG is named ``<mask stem>_<object><A>-<B>.png``, so a pair keeps the field it came from and the two labels in its name.
records.label: spacr._merge_pairs#3
records.source: A PNG is named ``<mask stem>_<object><A>-<B>.png``, so a pair keeps the field it came from and the two labels in its name.
records.translation: PNG 이름은 ``<mask stem>_<object><A>-<B>.png`` 이므로, 쌍의 이름에 원래 시야와 두 레이블이 남습니다.

records.context: The display range of each image layer is fixed for the whole set: the 1st and 99.8th percentile of pixels pooled from every pair window. No extracted image region is stretched on its own, so two pairs that look alike are alike.
records.label: spacr._merge_pairs#4
records.source: The display range of each image plane is fixed for the whole set: the 1st and 99.8th percentile of pixels pooled from every pair window. No crop is stretched on its own, so two pairs that look alike are alike.
records.translation: 각 이미지 평면의 표시 범위는 세트 전체에 고정됩니다. 모든 쌍 창에서 모은 픽셀의 1번째와 99.8번째 백분위수입니다. 어떤 크롭도 따로 늘리지 않으므로 비슷해 보이는 두 쌍은 실제로 비슷합니다.

records.context: Choose extracted image regions out of a folder of ``*.png`` or ``*.tif``, reading no pixels.
records.label: spacr.crop_loader.plan_from_folder#0
records.source: Choose crops out of a folder of ``*.png`` or ``*.tif``, reading no pixels.
records.translation: ``*.png`` 또는 ``*.tif`` 폴더에서 픽셀을 읽지 않고 크롭을 고릅니다.

records.context: PNGs are read as the 8-bit display extracted image regions they are. A folder with no PNG and with ``.tif`` or ``.tiff`` files is read raw: 16-bit and multichannel extracted image regions keep their values and every image layer.
records.label: spacr.crop_loader.plan_from_folder#1
records.source: PNGs are read as the 8-bit display crops they are. A folder with no PNG and with ``.tif`` or ``.tiff`` files is read raw: 16-bit and multichannel crops keep their values and every plane.
records.translation: PNG는 본래 그대로 8비트 표시용 크롭으로 읽습니다. PNG가 없고 ``.tif`` 또는 ``.tiff`` 파일이 있는 폴더는 원본 그대로 읽으므로 16비트 및 다중 채널 크롭의 값과 모든 평면이 유지됩니다.

records.context: what to select. Only ``path`` and ``limit`` apply: a folder records no class and no plate, and saying so in :attr:`CropPlan.source_label` is better than filtering on a filename convention that no run guarantees.
records.label: spacr.crop_loader.plan_from_folder#2
records.source: what to select. Only ``path`` and ``limit`` apply: a folder records no class and no plate, and saying so in :attr:`CropPlan.source_label` is better than filtering on a filename convention that no run guarantees.
records.translation: 선택할 대상입니다. ``path`` 와 ``limit`` 만 적용됩니다. 폴더에는 클래스도 마이크로플레이트도 기록되지 않으며, 어떤 처리 세션도 보장하지 않는 파일 이름 규칙으로 필터링하는 것보다 :attr:`CropPlan.source_label` 에 그 사실을 밝히는 편이 낫습니다.

records.context: a :class:`CropPlan`, possibly an empty one carrying :attr:`CropPlan.empty_reason`.
records.label: spacr.crop_loader.plan_from_folder#3
records.source: a :class:`CropPlan`, possibly an empty one carrying :attr:`CropPlan.empty_reason`.
records.translation: :class:`CropPlan` 이며, :attr:`CropPlan.empty_reason` 을 담은 빈 계획일 수도 있습니다.

records.context: no folder was chosen, or it is not a directory.
records.label: spacr.crop_loader.plan_from_folder#4
records.source: no folder was chosen, or it is not a directory.
records.translation: 폴더가 선택되지 않았거나 디렉터리가 아닐 때 발생합니다.
